video.title: DevOps Roadmap : Top 5 skills required to become Devops Engineer in 2023

transcript.text: devops Engineers are one of the highest
paid Professionals in the tech industry
today amazing if you want to become a
devops engineer these are the skills
that you need to know number one cloud
computing knowledge of cloud platforms
like AWS Azure gcp along with
containerization tools like Docker and
kubernetes is very important for any
devops engineer number two automation
automating software delivery process is
a crucial task of devops so knowledge of
scripting languages like python Ruby go
is very important for devops engineers
number three is CI CD a devops engineer
needs to know how to set up and manage
cicd pipelines using tools like Jenkins
Circle Ci or gitlab but 4 is IAC or
infrastructure as code a devops engineer
should have the ability to write code
and automate infrastructure provisioning
and configuration using tools like
ansible and terraform number five is
monitoring devops engineer needs to have
strong skill in monitoring and Metric
using tools like Prometheus grafana or
nagios to track the performance of your
applications and systems
